Maya R.: Quick heads-up — expecting 3 vendor visitors today around 4pm. Front desk will use a temporary guest code for the shared door. Please meet guests in the lobby and grab lanyards from the top drawer by the sign-in tablet. If you’re escorting, ping @front-desk.
Front Desk Bot: Package received: brown box for 'M. Chen' (DHL). Placed on mail shelf row B. Will hold until 5:00pm.
Kevin T.: FYI, need a hotdesk for a contractor 3pm–6pm. Is the window area free?
Lisa H.: Hot-desk board updated — window seat #5 is booked 2pm–6pm today. Use #hotdesk to reserve next time.
Jorge P.: Maya — do we still have vendor badge stickers? Lanyards sometimes dry up on busy days.
Maya R.: Yep, there are temporary badge stickers in the supply closet — top shelf next to the printer. I’ll bring a spare pack to the front desk at 3:30. Also please remind vendors to sign NDA on the tablet.
Front Desk Bot: Reminder: visitor badge stickers located on supply shelf near printer. If you take more than 3, please log it in the office-supplies thread.
Kevin T.: Thanks — grabbing one now. Will meet vendors in the lobby at 3:55.
Lisa H.: :thumbsup: I’ll escort two of them to the 4pm meeting room.
Maya R.: Thanks team — short notice but we’re covered. If anything changes, post in #people-ops so front desk sees it fast.
